verdict.topBlocker: Unlisted public OAuth apps are capped at 25 installed accounts, so beyond a pilot you need the Marketplace listing, and that requires 3 active installs plus Ecosystem Quality review.
verdict.summary: No HubSpot review is needed before outside customers can connect: create a Projects-based app with distribution set to marketplace, configure OAuth and sign the AUP, and up to 25 accounts can install right away (they see an unverified-app confirmation). Marketplace listing (about 10 business days initial review, up to 60 days total) and later certification are optional and only lift the 25-install cap or add trust; after install, each account gets 110 requests per 10 seconds, 30-minute access tokens and non-expiring refresh tokens.
verdict.reason: The guide treated the optional Marketplace listing review as the approval wait. HubSpot docs show OAuth installs work without review once the AUP is signed, capped at 25 accounts. App creation also moved from the dashboard to the CLI/Projects model in May-June 2026.

optionalPaths.name: HubSpot App Marketplace listing
optionalPaths.why: Any AI agent product expecting more than 25 customer accounts needs it to remove the install cap and the unverified-app warning. It requires 3 active installs, a setup guide, ToS/privacy URLs and the Partner Program Agreement. The wait is 10 business days (about 14 calendar days) for initial review and up to 60 days for the full feedback cycle.
optionalPaths.evidence: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/developer-platform/list-apps/listing-your-app/app-marketplace-listing-requirements "will complete an initial review within 10 business days"

optionalPaths.name: HubSpot Certified App
optionalPaths.why: Only for vendors wanting a badge and more Marketplace visibility; not needed for OAuth or scale. It requires 6 months listed and 60 active unaffiliated installs, then about 10 business days for the response and up to 60 days of feedback.
optionalPaths.evidence: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/developer-platform/list-apps/apply-for-certification/certification-requirements "must be listed in the HubSpot Marketplace for at least six months"

optionalPaths.name: Verified domain
optionalPaths.why: Optional for unlisted apps: it shows your domain on the install screen instead of an 'unverified' banner, which builds trust during the 25-install phase. A DNS TXT record usually verifies within an hour, up to 48 hours.
optionalPaths.evidence: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/developer-platform/build-apps/manage-apps-in-hubspot (verified domain section; via search summary) "up to 48 hours for the new DNS information to propagate"

limits.limit: Unlisted marketplace-distributed OAuth apps: max 25 installed accounts (developer test accounts excluded); privately distributed apps: 10 allowlisted accounts
limits.impact: An AI agent product can launch to 25 customer HubSpot accounts without review, but needs the Marketplace listing to grow beyond that, so a listing is practically required at scale.
limits.evidence: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/developer-platform/build-apps/manage-apps-in-hubspot "can be installed in up to 25 accounts (not including developer test accounts)"

limits.limit: API rate limit for publicly distributed OAuth apps: 110 requests per 10 seconds per installing account (CRM Search API excluded and limited separately); the limit-increase add-on does not apply
limits.impact: Agent tool calls must be throttled per customer account, and bursty multi-step agent runs can hit 429s.
limits.evidence: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/developer-tooling/platform/usage-guidelines "each HubSpot account that installs your app is limited to 110 requests every 10 seconds"

limits.limit: Access tokens last 30 minutes; refresh tokens do not currently expire unless the app is uninstalled or the token is revoked
limits.impact: The agent backend must refresh tokens about every 30 minutes and store refresh tokens securely per tenant.
limits.evidence: https://developers.hubspot.com/blog/oauth-token-management-hubspot-integrations "The access token is good for 30 minutes"

limits.limit: Required scopes block install if the account's tier lacks the feature; many scopes are tier-gated (for example custom objects and sensitive data scopes are Enterprise only)
limits.impact: Put non-essential scopes in optional_scope so customers on lower tiers can still connect the agent.
limits.evidence: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/developer-platform/build-apps/authentication/scopes optional scopes "must be authorized by the user only if they're present" (conditionally required); optional scopes don't block installation

limits.limit: Installer must be a Super Admin or have Marketplace Access permission
limits.impact: Ordinary end users at a customer often cannot connect the agent themselves and need an admin to install it.
limits.evidence: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/developer-platform/build-apps/authentication/oauth/working-with-oauth "must either be a Super Admin or have HubSpot Marketplace Access permissions"

limits.limit: Marketplace-listed apps must keep the API error rate under 5% for certification
limits.impact: Only matters if you pursue certification; noisy agent retries count against it.
limits.evidence: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/developer-tooling/platform/usage-guidelines "must stay under this 5% limit to be certified"

stepChanges.newTitle: Create a Projects-based app with the HubSpot CLI
stepChanges.newDetail: Install HubSpot CLI v7.6.0+, run hs account auth, then hs project create (choose App, OAuth auth, distribution 'marketplace'), then hs project upload. Copy the client ID and secret from the app's Auth tab. Legacy UI app creation was disabled in May-June 2026.
stepChanges.reason: Legacy public app creation in the UI was sunset; new public apps must use the CLI/Projects model.

stepChanges.newTitle: Configure scopes and redirect URLs in app-hsmeta.json
stepChanges.newDetail: Set auth.requiredScopes / optionalScopes and auth.redirectUrls in app-hsmeta.json (https in production; http only for localhost; no IP addresses), then run hs project upload. Put non-essential scopes in optional scopes so installs don't fail on lower-tier accounts.
stepChanges.reason: Owner and mechanism are config-file + CLI. The guide omitted the IP-address rule and optional scopes.

stepChanges.newDetail: POST URL-form-encoded to https://api.hubapi.com/oauth/v3/token with grant_type=authorization_code, client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri and code in the body. Access tokens expire in 30 minutes; refresh with grant_type=refresh_token.
stepChanges.reason: The linked guide is the deprecated v1 API, which retires February 16, 2027.

stepChanges.newTitle: Sign the AUP to allow installs in customer accounts
stepChanges.newDetail: In Development > Projects > your app > Distribution, sign the Acceptable Use Policy. The app can then be installed by up to 25 non-test accounts with no HubSpot review; users see an unverified-app confirmation step.
stepChanges.reason: This is the last required step for OAuth to work for outside customers. The guide framed it as just unlocking review submission.
Marketplace listing is optional and only needed beyond 25 installs. It also requires 3 active installs first.
The Ecosystem Quality review applies only to the optional listing; it does not gate OAuth installs.

missing: Unlisted marketplace OAuth apps are capped at 25 installed accounts until listed; privately distributed apps at 10 allowlisted accounts. https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/developer-platform/build-apps/manage-apps-in-hubspot

Listing requires at least three active, unique installs before submission, and only one app can be under review at a time. https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/developer-platform/list-apps/listing-your-app/app-marketplace-listing-requirements

Legacy public app creation in the UI was disabled May 26, 2026 (new accounts) and June 23, 2026 (existing accounts); new apps must use CLI/Projects. https://developers.hubspot.com/changelog/legacy-public-app-creation-sunset
Rate limit for public OAuth apps is 110 requests per 10 seconds per installing account. https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/developer-tooling/platform/usage-guidelines

Unlisted/unverified app installs show an extra user confirmation step; a verified domain (DNS TXT) reduces the warning. https://developers.hubspot.com/changelog/new-confirmation-step-for-unverified-third-party-app-installs

Refresh tokens currently do not expire unless the app is uninstalled or the token is revoked; v1 OAuth endpoints are deprecated (v3 recommended). https://developers.hubspot.com/blog/oauth-token-management-hubspot-integrations
Redirect URLs cannot be IP addresses; a domain is required. https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/developer-platform/build-apps/authentication/oauth/working-with-oauth
